successors.name: Qujialing culture
successors.text: "centered in the Three Gorges region around the middle Yangtze", "western Hubei"

ledger.x: 5000 BCE: the Daxi culture holds the Three Gorges, from western Hubei to eastern Sichuan ("The Daxi culture (5000-3300 BC)").
3300 BCE: the Chongqing side of the Three Gorges is left empty when the Daxi ends; the Qujialing page places its culture in Hubei and Hunan only, and no other culture is named for Sichuan.
3300 BCE: the Daxi ends ("5000-3300 BC") and the Qujialing takes the western Hubei Three Gorges ("The Daxi culture was followed by the Qujialing culture").

certainty.note: No border is recorded; the gorges are the natural axis.
